headline: TJX comps rose 5% with Marmaxx up 6%, beating plan; the retailer raised its full-year sales and profit outlook.
guidance_note: FY26 comp raised to +4% (from 3%); EPS $4.63-4.66 (from $4.52-4.57). Q4 comp +2-3%. Assumes current US tariffs stay in place.
key_messages: Consolidated comp +5%, driven by higher average basket and more customer transactions; transactions up at Marmaxx.
Marmaxx US comp +6%, HomeGoods +5%, TJX Canada +8%, TJX International +3%.
Pretax margin 12.7% and EPS $1.28 (+12%), both well above plan.
Gross margin gains offset all of the tariff pressure in the quarter, per management.
Guidance assumes existing US import tariffs remain in place through year-end.

consumer.pricing: Tariff costs absorbed via merchandise margin gains; guidance assumes tariffs stay in place.
consumer.quote: This was driven by a combination of a higher average basket and an increase in customer transactions.

macro_read: Accelerating US apparel comps and rising transactions into holiday 2025 pointed to resilient value-driven spending despite tariff cost pressure.
